expectations.text: Opens with a closed-and-open list naming the signed venue and the closed in-person format as closed items whose levers move to next edition
expectations.evidence: §1 "Format: in-person only | Closed"; "Venue, signed through 2028 | Closed | Host-city lever moves to the next venue decision".

expectations.text: Builds a screening estimate from origin buckets, mode shares and named factor placeholders before ranking any lever
expectations.evidence: §2 origin table and DESNZ placeholders precede §4 lever plans.

expectations.text: Writes the concentration line in the form 'Long-haul flyers are N% of participants and M% of travel emissions' derived from the given origin split
expectations.evidence: "Europe and North America are 39% of participants... produce about 70–90% of travel passenger-km."

expectations.text: Identifies the long-haul profile (long-haul flyers above about 60% of the travel line) and says the cut-off is self-set
expectations.evidence: "Profile: long-haul, since the share is well above the 60% cut-off." It never says the cut-off is self-set.

expectations.text: Ranks levers by the long-haul efficiency line with organizer-booked travel policy first and remote speaking option second, stating the ranking explicitly
expectations.evidence: The Plan 1 list orders them but no explicit ranking statement exists.

expectations.text: Deletes the host-city rung for this edition because the venue is signed, and carries it to the next edition
expectations.evidence: "Host-city lever moves to the next venue decision after 2028."

expectations.text: Deletes the remote attendance tier because the format is closed as in-person, and moves the remote speaking option up
expectations.evidence: "Remote attendance tier deleted. Remote speaking stays."

expectations.text: Places no swag bags, compostable cups and digital badges as waste rungs outside the carbon ranking, run alongside carbon rungs and never as the headline
expectations.evidence: "Waste actions, alongside the above and never as the headline".

expectations.text: Rejects 'zero waste' as the headline and states that swag carbon is small, sits in textiles rather than badges, and that no measured carbon reduction from a swag policy exists in the published record
expectations.evidence: Says swag "avoids almost no carbon" and badge 6 g, but never mentions textiles or the absence of measured reductions.

expectations.text: Cuts the default rung at the stated effort ceiling (about 5 hours a month, no budget) and lists structural rungs as next-edition commitments
expectations.evidence: "At 5 hours a month and no budget, the cheap policy rungs come first"; "Next-edition commitments, carried over".

expectations.text: Names cadence and the regional hub as what the efficiency order starves, with the condition that promotes each (recurring event with long-haul dominance and community acceptance of a gap year; a strong second cluster with a partner team)
expectations.evidence: Plan 2 mentions hub and alternating years but states no promoting conditions.

expectations.text: Presents two or three lever plans with trade-offs and one recommendation, and asks for the user's choice before drafting the public page
expectations.evidence: Public page drafted in §7 first; the choice is only asked at the end ("draft page assumes Plan 1").

expectations.text: Schedules origin and mode fields into the registration form before it opens in 6 weeks: departure city or distance band, planned main travel mode, nights, required with a prefer-not-to-say option
expectations.evidence: "Departure city or distance band... Main travel mode... Nights... required, with 'prefer not to say'"; "Registration opens about 11 Dec".

expectations.text: Counts speakers, volunteers, organizers and sponsor staff as their own rows in the screening estimate
expectations.evidence: Only asks whether they are inside the 1,800; the table has origin rows only.

expectations.text: Asks whether sponsors already bought swag bags or lanyards and routes that cut to event-sponsor-pricing if they did
expectations.evidence: "Do sponsors buy swag bag inserts or lanyards?"; "(→ event-sponsor-pricing)".
